## 主张 Claim

对每条带动作的变化之律与每个约化：约化值上有一条确定的律承载每一步，当且仅当约化合并的构型被每个动作带到它合并的构型；与每个动作交换的约化律与每段动作序列交换。在明示两量子位实振幅片段中，实际相位操作保留双方完整局部密度与联合基底分布，而同一后续受控 X 操作产生不同控制响应；所以局部密度对不承载规律，不能统一给出下一控制状态。保留相应共同交叉项的四整数摘要承载规律，对指定交互与相位操作的任意有限序列给出精确控制密度和响应：两者都是实例。 / For every law of change with moves and every reduction: some determined law on the reduced values carries every step exactly when configurations the reduction merges are taken by each move to configurations it merges; a reduced law that commutes with every move commutes with every course of moves. In the specified two-qubit real-amplitude fragment, an actual phase operation preserves both complete local densities and the joint basis distribution, while the same subsequent controlled-X gives different control responses; so the local density pair carries no law and cannot uniformly determine the next control state. A four-integer summary retaining the relevant joint cross contribution carries one, giving exact control densities and responses for every finite word of the supplied interaction and phase operations: both are instances.

Canonical source: [RelationalReduction.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/RelationalReduction.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 整数实振幅与密度分子；主要物理见证的振幅除以根号2，密度除以2，最终省略见证的范数为1。任意整数输入的一般结论是代数恒等式。 / Integer real amplitudes and density numerators; main physical witnesses divide amplitudes by sqrt 2 and densities by 2, while the final omission witnesses have norm 1. General integer-input conclusions are algebraic identities.
- H制备、受控X、第一坐标Z、偏迹与测量含义来自明示量子框架；共同操作的实际访问条件保留。 / H preparation, controlled-X, first-coordinate Z, partial trace and measurement interpretation are supplied by the declared quantum framework; actual joint-operation access remains required.
- 任意有限词精确性限于两类指定操作及第一坐标响应；复用既有SystemsOrganization的同一状态接续定理。 / All-finite-word exactness is restricted to the two specified operations and first-coordinate responses; it reuses the existing SystemsOrganization theorem preserving reached-state composition.

同一制备中分化的两个坐标表示操作角色。相位实际改变共同振幅关系，再以相同交互和测量比较后续；summary_update_exact的输出满足旧evolve_semiconjugacy的输入，summary_recovers_control连接测量。标准量子效应及一般约化定理不作为新发现。 / Two coordinates differentiate operation roles within one preparation. Phase changes the joint amplitude relation before a common interaction and measurement compare continuations. summary_update_exact supplies the old evolve_semiconjugacy premise, and summary_recovers_control connects its output to measurement. Neither the standard quantum effect nor the general reduction theorem is claimed as a new discovery.
